title: KPEVAL: Towards Fine-Grained Semantic-Based Keyphrase Evaluation
reasoning: The paper introduces a new keyphrase evaluation framework called KPEVAL. While it includes an aspect named 'faithfulness,' this refers to whether keyphrase predictions are grounded in the source document, not to religious faith, morals, or ethics. There are no sections or discussions related to ethical considerations, moral implications, or religious topics as a core component of the research.
